srList.sentence: Materials and methods Study design and cohorts A multicentre, cross-sectional (2006-2017) comparative study assessed people with MS (2010 McDonald criteria 3 ) without VRF (N = 93, mean age = 47.2 +- 8.2 years, 63.4 females), with VRF (N = 108, mean age = 48.5 +- 8.5 years, 62.0 females) and a non-MS group with VRF (N = 43, mean age = 58.5 +- 13.8 years, 61.7 females).
